entities.name: Vicyohandri Odelín
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vicyohandri Odelín Sanamé is a former right-handed pitcher for the Cuban national baseball team and Camagüey of the Cuban National Series. Nicknamed "Villo", Odelín represented Cuba internationally, winning a gold medal at the 2004 Olympics, a silver at the inaugural 2006 World Baseball Classic, and another silver at the 2008 Olympics.
